🆕 NEW RELEASE: Fox & Badger release Soft Skin with first music video

Hamburg pop-punk band Fox & Badger have released the single "Soft Skin" together with their first music video. It follows "Consequences" from the end of August and the 2025 debut EP "Inner Bloom". Singer Laura describes the song as being about the difficulty of leaving a toxic relationship.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Sleeping With Sirens announce five German shows for 2027

Sleeping With Sirens bring their An Ending In Itself tour to Germany in February 2027, with shows in Munich, Berlin, Hamburg, Stuttgart and Cologne. Arm's Length and Like Roses are confirmed as support. The tour follows the album An Ending In Itself, released on 12 June 2026 via Rise Records.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Simple Plan and New Found Glory join When We Were Young 2027

Simple Plan and New Found Glory have been added to the lineup of When We Were Young 2027. The festival takes place on 16 October 2027 in Las Vegas. The first wave also includes blink-182, All Time Low, Pierce The Veil, The Used and Taking Back Sunday.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Underoath confirm 23-date tour with Saosin, nine in Germany

Underoath have confirmed a 23-date UK and European headline tour for April and May 2027, with Saosin and I Promised The World supporting on every show. Germany gets nine stops, opening at Berlin's Astra Kulturhaus on 2 April and including Hamburg, Leipzig, Cologne, Munich and Stuttgart.

🆕 NEW RELEASE: The Manges release new EP Believe It

Italian pop-punk veterans The Manges have released a three-song EP called "Believe It" through Striped Records in Italy and Mom's Basement Records in the US. Mass Giorgini produced it, and it is the band's first new release since the 2022 album Book Of Hate For Good People.
